_comment: Registry data. Anything the UI used to spell out inline as an array or a literal range lives here: what order tiles appear in a picker, which levels of detail exist, which tab widths an editor offers. The renderers keep the behaviour; this file keeps the vocabulary, so adding a kind or a tab width is a data edit rather than a hunt through the app.

lod.note: live draws, frozen keeps its last frame, card shows a summary, culled is not built until seen.

selection.note: the item taxonomy the selection pane counts, in reading order
